Asha: quick update 10: spun a 5% canary of v6-quant4-longdoc this morning. Shadow vs v5.1-fp16 shows an MRR drop on >2k token slice (~-11%) and p95 latency +30ms. No hallucination uptick. Anyone seen kv-cold + quant jitter combo? :thinking:

Liam: pasted reduced stats from the shadow run:
```
slice: longdoc_topN
metric: rerank_mrr
v5.1-fp16: 0.438
v6-quant4: 0.390
delta: -0.048 (-11.0%)
latency.p95: 170ms -> 200ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.8% -> 2.4%
```
Signals concentrated when kv_warmup_count < 5 requests.

Ravi: current rollout auto-fallbacks are mrr_drop 7% and halluc_abs 2%. For longdocs we should tighten. Proposal: auto-fallback if any of: mrr_drop > 5% OR p95_latency_increase > 20ms OR kv_warmup_miss_rate > 1%. That would have aborted.

Asha: applying patch to canary policy now and scaling down live canary to 1% while we investigate. Patch snippet applied to rollout config. Also scheduling an expanded shadow run with route-level kv_warmup=12 to pre-fill caches.

Liam: short-term mitigation: I'll push a routing override for canary pool to set kv_warmup=12 for scoring routes. No model change, just routing. Opening CL. :wrench:

Ravi: also adding a lightweight "logit variance" probe to the canary dashboard to detect kernel jitter early. If variance correlates with MRR drop we flag automatically.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2044 opened: "v6-quant4 longdoc rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Asha: plan: 1) enforce stricter auto-fallback (done), 2) run expanded shadow with kv_warmup=12, 3) collect variance probe + kernel traces, 4) decide rollback vs rebaseline. Tagging @platform for infra warmup help. :thumbsup:
